entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, um... There's something I want[n]to talk to you about, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's Shiho.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well... I went to visit her in the hospital.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She... She said she was sorry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry for not telling me about[n]Kamoshida... about all the things[n]he was doing to her...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But it was my fault too. I didn't[n]realize how much trouble she was[n]in... I wasn't there for her...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, I apologized as well.
Are you feeling better now?
She's so strong.[clr 27]
So are you friends again?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mm-hm! I finally got to tell her everything[n]I couldn't bring myself to say before.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* Isn't she? Shiho[n]really is a great girl.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm glad I finally got to tell her everything[n]I couldn't bring myself to say before.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, it's more like we're even better[n]friends. I've rediscovered just how[n]much I care about her.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm glad I finally got to tell her everything[n]I couldn't bring myself to say before.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And, um... remember how Kamoshida[n]threatened to take Shiho off the[n]team if I didn't sleep with him?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I had only agreed to it so that[n]I wouldn't ruin Shiho's dreams...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But now that I think about it, he never[n]would have put her on the bench and[n]cost his team games...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I seriously should have dared him[n]to try and take her starting spot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...But in the end, maybe I just[n]didn't believe in her ability.
You can't blame yourself.
You might be right.[clr 27]
Kamoshida had the upper hand.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You think so...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All of this happened[n]because of how weak I am...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's why I believed Kamoshida's[n]authority outweighed Shiho's own[n]ability to earn her starting spot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I knew it... I'm so stupid...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All of this happened[n]because of how weak I am...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's why I believed Kamoshida's[n]authority outweighed Shiho's own[n]ability to earn her starting spot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That might have been true...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But honestly, I think it was all[n]because of how weak I am...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's why I believed Kamoshida's[n]authority outweighed Shiho's own[n]ability to earn her starting spot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: [fName], do you remember the last[n]time I talked to you like this?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: When I got that phone call[n]from Kamoshida... and cried.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I felt so alone... scared, even...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But because you were there[n]for me, I decided not to go.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was a little surprised at how[n]pushy you were about it... but I[n]see now you just wanted to help.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Thanks.
It was no big deal.
I couldn't just ignore you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was though... Really, it meant a lot to me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're so kind, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Back then, people used to[n]call me all sorts of names...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Prissy bitch," "Kamoshida's girl"...[n]I got tired of it pretty quickly.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But to tell you the truth, someday I want[n]to be able to take labels like that in stride.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, um... Personas are the[n]power of the heart, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That means if my heart gets[n]stronger, my Persona will too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So... I want to strengthen my heart.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And I want to use that strength[n]to help the people around me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope we can save people from[n]trouble, just like we did when[n]we changed Kamoshida's heart.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Though honestly... I don't[n]even know what "strong" is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I'm going to find the answer, I promise.
I'll help.[clr 27]
Let's find it together.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Really!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks! I feel like I'm[n]a little stronger already!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* I guess that doesn't[n]really count though, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Really...!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks! I feel like I'm[n]a little stronger already!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* I guess that doesn't[n]really count though, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well... I'll be relying on you.[n]Let's train together and make[n]our hearts super strong!
I sense a heightened[n]motivation from Ann...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A strong heart... Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How about this: I won't get any[n]refills on fountain drinks!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, they're free, so not getting any[n]would mean you have a strong heart!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Is that not right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, see you later.
